evals.prompt: 帮我搜一下最近一周关于AI Agent的新闻，中文的，要5条就行，总结一下主要趋势
evals.expected_output: Agent uses volcengine-web-search (Custom edition, default) with --json --count 5 --time-range week, runs the uv script, reads Summary fields, and synthesizes trend highlights in Chinese with source attribution.

evals.prompt: 找几张故宫雪景的照片，我要用来做电脑壁纸，最好是横版高清的
evals.expected_output: Agent uses --type image with --orientation landscape and --min-short-edge for wallpaper use, presents image URLs with dimensions and clarity info.

evals.prompt: 我想了解最新的新能源汽车政策，要权威来源的信息，政府网站最好
evals.expected_output: Agent uses Custom edition with --json --authoritative-only (and ideally --industry gov), synthesizes findings from authoritative sources, citing sites and links.

evals.prompt: Look up what OpenAI announced in the last couple of weeks — I need English-language and overseas sources, the Chinese search engines weren't giving me much
evals.expected_output: Agent recognizes the overseas/English need and switches to the Global edition with --global (--edition global), uses --json, and synthesizes from global Documents/Snippet results.

evals.prompt: 我手上有张商品截图 https://p11-volcsearch-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-xstd03g9pf/5708180019264f8197000b1c6678cd81~tplv-obj.jpeg?lk3s=1515c32d&scene=volc_search&x-expires=1796281042&x-signature=DQT9FvDybZG8Kk1s0sNlIiVMotw%3D ，帮我在网上找找同款或相似的图片
evals.expected_output: Agent recognizes image-to-image search requires Global visual mode: --global --type visual --image-url <url>, runs it, and presents visually similar results with links.
